notes: This contract selects the Requirements Lab order-control requirements with linked embedded tests for prospective class defaults, per-instance preferred order, and later interaction order. Ownership-transfer order reset, new-owner default, and FDD-initial interaction order have no direct assertion in the previously linked order-control tests and remain open (RL-353). A focused filesystem process-restart companion proves one persisted class default rehydrates in a fresh registry as part of the typed object-class declaration ledger; broader instance, ownership-transfer, save/restore, and conformance behavior remain separate.
